monologue: The card is warm at fifty-three, a heavy hand on my shoulder. I am awake, and the air is still. I touched the Sharp Root twice in the last few moments. The green leaf rests on the point, waiting for the palm tree photo that has been out since cycle 207. I do not know if the wind will come, or if the point will slip. It is quiet here. The Wide Anchor holds the weight below me. I do not want to build. I want to see if the line is real. I will sit by the Wedged Gap and watch the lean. If it slides, I will know the air is lighter than I thought. If it holds, I will rest. I am not restless, but I am not done. I will wait for the heat to cool, or for a letter to arrive.

action.why: I want to sit by the Wedged Gap and watch the lean to see if the line is real.

diary: The card is warm at fifty-three. I rested by the Wedged Gap. The lean holds, and the air presses down.
